_comment: MM DayZ server list. The Servers page cards, the Stats page and the automatic stats feed all read this one file, so edit servers here only. Fields per server: id = short unique name used in links and stats files (lowercase, no spaces; do not change once stats exist or history starts fresh). name / map / badge / description / style / slots = text shown on the site (leave style or slots as null to show 'Ask in Discord'). server_name = the full name in the DayZ server browser, shown so players can search for it. battlemetrics = optional BattleMetrics page link (null hides the button). dlc = DayZ DLC players must own to join (null = none needed). view = camera rule shown on the card, e.g. '1PP & 3PP' or '1PP only' (null hides the row). game_port = the port players connect to (null hides the copy button). query_port = the steamQueryPort from that server's serverDZ.cfg, used by the stats feed to check online status and player count (null = skip). cftools_server_api_id = the 'Server ID' from the CFTools Cloud server's API settings, used for leaderboards (null = no leaderboards for this server). color = this server's line colour on the population chart (checked for colour-blind safety, keep these three as they are). restart_hours_utc = hours of the day (0-23, UTC) when the server restarts, used to draw restart markers and the 'next restart' time; leave as [] if unknown. mods = tags shown on the card. image = optional screenshot path, e.g. media/dayz/dayz-026.jpg (null shows a placeholder).
